editing_plan.title_suggestion: Your Degree Didn't Get You Here? The TRUTH!
editing_plan.hook_strategy: Start with a tight, slightly off-center shot of the speaker, then a rapid punch zoom on the word 'degrees' as he asks the question. A bold, animated text overlay 'Did your degree REALLY get you here?' flashes on screen, accompanied by a quick, sharp sound effect to grab immediate attention.

segments.editing_note: Quick cut, slightly wider shot of speaker.
Slight push-in on speaker, serious tone.

segments.caption_text: How many think degrees got you here?
segments.editing_note: Punch zoom on speaker's face, intense eye contact.

segments.broll_idea: Quick cut to a diverse group of successful-looking professionals (e.g., in a modern office, a startup space) shaking their heads 'no' or shrugging, looking unimpressed.
segments.editing_note: Fast cut to B-roll, quick pan across faces, dramatic sound effect.
Return to speaker, confident nod, slight smile.

segments.caption_text: Then why did you do the degree?
segments.editing_note: Dramatic pause, speaker leans in, curious expression. Slow zoom out.

segments.broll_idea: B-roll of a student looking stressed at a laptop with a university website showing tuition fees, or a stack of bills/student loan statements.
segments.editing_note: Quick cut to B-roll, slightly shaky cam for tension, question mark graphic overlay.
Return to speaker, raised eyebrow, skeptical look. Quick text animation for numbers.
Speaker gestures to audience, expectant look. Quick cuts between speaker and imagined audience.

segments.broll_idea: B-roll of a calculator displaying a large number (e.g., 1,200,000) or a hand counting a stack of money, then a quick cut to a student looking overwhelmed.
segments.editing_note: Fast cut to B-roll, dramatic sound effect, large number graphic.

segments.caption_text: How much are your degrees? 15, 10 or below.
segments.editing_note: Return to speaker, quick cuts, slightly faster delivery, showing rapid audience interaction.
Speaker leans back slightly, a knowing look, building anticipation for the next thought. Hold shot for a beat.

editing_plan.caption_style: Dynamic, bold white text with a thin black outline and subtle shadow. Words animate in quickly (e.g., pop-up or slide-in) and disappear just as fast. Key phrases or numbers are highlighted with a contrasting color (e.g., yellow or red) for emphasis.
editing_plan.pacing_notes: Aggressive, fast-paced editing with frequent jump cuts (every 1-3 seconds). Use punch zooms on key words like 'degrees', 'zero', 'cost', 'lakhs'. Incorporate dramatic pauses after questions to build tension. Music should be a mix of inquisitive, slightly suspenseful, and then a quick, punchy beat drop for reveals. Emotional pacing shifts from questioning to revelation.
editing_plan.call_to_action: Was your degree worth it? Share your story in the comments! 👇 #DegreeDebate #EducationCost #CareerTruth

clips.clip_text: Do you know that Nike lost $25 billion in one day in market valuation just by trying to make everything data driven? Nike invested billions into something that was less effective but easier to measure versus something that was more effective but less easy to measure. Do you know Nike changed as a brand earlier they used to do these you know they used to get the best athletes and make them you know show they used to celebrate running they used to celebrate sports but they switched and they said no we'll go very tactical we'll go very measured and obviously it became a less aspirational brand the minute you make everything measurable and you're trying to sell sell

editing_plan.title_suggestion: Nike Lost $25 BILLION: The Data-Driven Mistake
editing_plan.hook_strategy: Start with a tight, slightly off-center shot of the speaker. As they say "Nike lost $25 billion," a quick, sharp punch zoom into their eyes, accompanied by a dramatic, low-frequency sound effect (like a deep thud or a quick, sharp bass drop). The text '$25 BILLION' flashes boldly on screen for 1 second.

segments.caption_text: Nike lost $25 BILLION in ONE DAY.
segments.editing_note: Punch zoom on speaker, dramatic sound effect, bold text overlay for '$25 BILLION'. Fast cut.

segments.broll_idea: Montage: stock market ticker crashing, abstract data visualizations, a person looking stressed at multiple screens with graphs.
segments.editing_note: Quick cuts, intense, slightly desaturated B-roll. Build tension with sound design.

segments.caption_text: Invested in less effective, easier to measure.
segments.editing_note: Return to speaker, slight zoom out. Emphasize 'less effective' with a subtle head shake.

segments.broll_idea: Split screen: Left side: generic product shot with sales numbers overlay. Right side: a lone runner pushing through a difficult terrain, looking determined (more abstract, emotional).
segments.caption_text: Vs. more effective, harder to measure.
segments.editing_note: Visual contrast, quick cuts between the two sides. Music shifts slightly to more inspiring on the right.
Speaker, slightly wider shot. Pacing picks up slightly, a sense of revelation.

segments.broll_idea: Montage of iconic, old Nike ads: Michael Jordan flying, athletes pushing limits, people joyfully running, 'Just Do It' slogan in classic font. Focus on emotion and aspiration.
segments.caption_text: Used to celebrate running, celebrate sports.
segments.editing_note: Uplifting, inspiring music. Smooth, cinematic cuts. Nostalgic feel.

segments.caption_text: But they switched: very tactical, very measured.
segments.editing_note: Return to speaker, slight punch zoom on 'switched'. Tone becomes more critical.

segments.broll_idea: Montage of modern, sterile Nike ads: product shots with price tags, data dashboards, people looking at phones, generic gym scenes. Less emotion, more direct sales.
segments.editing_note: Music shifts to a more neutral, almost clinical tone. Faster, less emotional cuts. Visuals feel less inspiring.

segments.caption_text: When you make everything measurable, you just sell, sell, sell.
segments.editing_note: Speaker returns, slightly closer shot. Emphasize 'sell, sell, sell' with a quick, repetitive zoom or visual stutter. Final impactful statement.

editing_plan.caption_style: Dynamic, bold white text with a black outline/shadow. Key words highlighted in yellow or a contrasting brand color. Appears and disappears quickly, synchronized with speech, often with a subtle bounce or pop animation.
editing_plan.pacing_notes: Rapid-fire cuts throughout, especially during B-roll segments. Utilize punch zooms on key phrases and numbers for emphasis. Dramatic pauses are minimal, used only for impact after a major statement. Music starts with a dramatic, attention-grabbing sound, shifts to inspiring for old Nike, then to a more neutral/disappointing tone for the 'new' Nike, ending on a thought-provoking note. Overall fast, high-energy pacing.
editing_plan.call_to_action: What do YOU think? Did Nike lose its soul chasing data? 👇 Comment below!
